slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A few recurring signs suggest a cash flow facility might be worth exploring — from consistently tight weeks to relying on personal funds to cover business costs. None of these are alarming on their own, but together they're worth noting.

caption:
None of these signs is a crisis on its own, but seeing several of them together is a useful early signal that a cash flow facility might be worth exploring — before the pressure builds further.

Recognising the pattern early gives you time to plan a considered response, rather than reacting under stress.
